confidence_notes: Numbeo's 15 October 2026 Koh Samui data (38 contributors over 18 months) lists an inexpensive meal at ฿150, a mid-range meal for two at ฿1,000, draft beer at ฿80 and cappuccino at ฿71.88. A Chaweng beachfront menu lists cocktails at ฿240 and wine by the glass at ฿250; these are single-venue prices and sit above the ฿80 beer reference. Hostelworld shows hostel “from” prices, not year-round typical rates; hotel anchors are rough estimates because I did not find an aggregated year-round hotel price.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Koh Samui-specific price observations; no comparable city used.
